clue.text: Compiler on public transport? On the contrary, composer

parts.note: a bus is a form of public transport
taken as written

explanation.surface: A setter takes the bus, or rather the bus takes a composer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Compiler on public transport' would read I ON BUS; 'On the contrary' flips it to BUS ON I.
explanation.definitionFit: Ferruccio Busoni was an Italian pianist and composer of the early twentieth century.
